subject: The journey from kitchen survey to fitting
hook: What do I need to sort before the kitchen fitters arrive?
fb:
What do I need to sort before the kitchen fitters arrive? A good question, and getting it right makes fitting days much smoother.

Clear the kitchen and the route in, and keep the drive or a parking space free for unloading. Agree who is taking out the old kitchen. Book any gas, electrical or plumbing work so services are in place. Set up a temporary kitchen in another room, and keep pets and little ones clear of the work area, especially with the school holidays on.

We'll confirm a full list for your own job before we start. Find out more about our installation service:
https://superiofurniture.com/furniture-installation/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=whole-home-bespoke-solutions&utm_content=day-343

What do I need to sort before the kitchen fitters arrive? It's one of the most useful questions to ask before a new kitchen is installed.

Here's what usually helps:
- Clear the kitchen and the route in, and keep a parking space free for unloading
- Agree who is removing the old kitchen
- Book any gas, electrical or plumbing work so services are ready
- Set up a temporary kitchen in another room
- Keep pets and children away from the work area
